priorityFindings.finding: Stage selection currently owns two aliases to one physical Corridor definition and launches its raw scene instead of admitting OLYMPUS-INVASION-01.
priorityFindings.effect: A single truthful selection row can launch the complete Corridor-to-Station route and remove catalog/result identity drift.
priorityFindings.dependency: P1-A full exit must be accepted before product P1-B implementation; the evidence packet may proceed earlier.
priorityFindings.risk: A second load authority or copied route fields would split run identity.

priorityFindings.finding: Power, target time, summon need, lesson, and mastery prose exist only in unjoined templates; loadout, restrictions, cost, story exit, and challenge references have no canonical owner.
priorityFindings.effect: A derived StageBriefingReadModel can expose only reviewed values and make every unsupported field explicitly absent.
priorityFindings.dependency: One reviewed template choice or explicit no-template arm for each new run.
priorityFindings.risk: Copying current strings into the catalog would preserve drift and make presentation look authoritative.

priorityFindings.finding: The Corridor definition stores a story-entry profile ID and Timeline path, but this preflight does not include the profile asset, actual PlayableDirector asset, GUID chain, or runtime consumer needed to classify their join.

priorityFindings.dependency: P1-B static spine join plus the existing P2-B lifecycle contract.
priorityFindings.risk: Treating a profile name or path as runtime proof can leave input, camera, HUD, or time-scale ownership split.

negativeBoundary: This report proves the named local report bytes, recorded 20-source manifest arithmetic, and the separately timestamped bounded negative searches only. The historical source snapshot currently replays 19/20; segment, pocket, role-slot, template-reference-count, and runtime cinematic-chain claims remain outside that manifest. It proves no PGR or HI3 row, does not authorize foreign IDs/text/formulas/layouts/assets, and does not close P1-B product acceptance.
